items.statement: The scenario may assume unusually high trust and adoption of the kOA/K ecosystem for stress-testing upper-bound monetary possibilities.
Monetary governance is institutionally delegated to a broad Smart Vote process rather than unilateral founder control.
Worker protection includes a real consumption floor during transition shocks.
Broad capital ownership is pursued through K_C/social-capital allocation rather than relying only on cash transfers.
Real productive capacity can be expanded through investment; nominal issuance alone is not treated as creation of real resources.
Sovereign tax acceptance, legal tender status and debt redenomination are external sovereign choices and are never implied by private adoption.
